stem: Which problem did George Washington encounter when he became president?

options.label: F
options.text: Southern states were threatening to secede from the Union.

options.label: G
options.text: The United States had large debts from the American Revolution.

options.label: H
options.text: Great Britain was refusing to trade with the United States.

options.label: J
options.text: The Articles of Confederation needed to be replaced with a stronger constitution.
